lead: From the time we start playing sports, we pretend to be our idols.
body: To show teen athletes what it truly takes to become the best, we created a campaign that allowed teens to become their favorite pro athletes through a variety of immersive experiences.

We created first person POV videos featuring Usain Bolt and Serena Williams, a 360° Virtual Reality experience featuring JJ Watt, and partnered with Spotify to allow users to choose workout playlists that match the intensity and training style of the featured pros.

modules.title: JJ Watt VR / 360° Video
modules.body: We created an immersive VR experience allowing aspiring pros to become JJ Watt. Using a custom-built VR array and binaural audio, we delivered an unprecedented live-action point of view of the speed, strength and sweat of JJ Watt.

modules.title: VR Roadshow
modules.body: The VR experience toured at sports camps and events across the county. It was also featured as one of the first branded YouTube 360° videos.

modules.title: Spotify Integration
modules.body: Partnering with Spotify, we were able to give athletes playlists that matched the musical tastes and training styles of our pros: Power, Agility & Speed.
